known_fusion_or_split.description: Some bacteria encode RNA polymerase beta and beta-prime as a single polypeptide. Family-profile coverage inside a longer protein plus partner-family evidence distinguishes a fusion orthologue from a domain fragment.
Adjacent ORFs on the same contig and strand may jointly cover the family profile in order. This is distinct from assembly fragmentation across contig boundaries.

msa_provenance.method: star multiple alignment seeded on NP_418414.1 using Needleman-Wunsch (match=1 mismatch=-1 gap=-1)

hmm_provenance.method: hmmbuild from the curated star MSA at first use

phylogenetic_reference_provenance.default: phylogenetic placement is not required for classification
phylogenetic_reference_provenance.used_when: cheaper evidence leaves paralogy or family identity ambiguous
